steps.sub: Decide when to stop up front

code:
p1, p2 = 0.10, 0.12
za = stats.norm.ppf(0.975)  # 1.96
zb = stats.norm.ppf(0.80)   # 0.842
pb = (p1 + p2) / 2
a = za*np.sqrt(2*pb*(1-pb))
b = zb*np.sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2))
n = (a + b)**2 / (p2 - p1)**2
print(int(np.ceil(n)))   # 3841
caption: 10% baseline to 12%: 3,841 users per group.

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
labels = np.repeat(
    ["control", "treatment"], 10)
group = rng.permutation(labels)
print((group == "control").sum())
# 10
caption: Balanced by construction; illustrative 20 users.

code:
# pval() = two-proportion z-test
hits = [pval(rng.binomial(N, p1),
             rng.binomial(N, p2),
             N) < .05
        for _ in range(2000)]
print(np.mean(hits))   # 0.805
# A/A test (p1 vs p1): ~5% significant
caption: True rates 10% vs 12%, N = 3,841 per group.
